scenes.brief: Show Figma logo with brand name and tagline.
Dynamic camera glide over a team collaborating in Figma, highlighting real-time design editing.
Hero still of a diverse design team presenting a finished prototype on a large screen.
Show how to create a new frame, add a rectangle, and rename it.
Call-to-action: Start designing today at figma.com.

beats.text: Figma invites designers to create together in real time.
A smooth camera glides across a bustling design team as they edit vectors, comment, and watch changes appear instantly together live.
A polished still shows a diverse group presenting a finished prototype on a large screen, celebrating the final design together today now.
First, select the frame tool, draw a blank canvas, then drag a rectangle onto it and rename the layer easily quickly today.
Start designing now today at figma.com for free.
